title: SCA Tish'a BeAb 2022: Mr. Ezra Dweck

chapters.title: Introduction to Tish'a BeAb customs
chapters.about: Mishna, Massaat, eating meat, drinking wine

chapters.title: Yehoshua and mourning the Bet HaMikdash
chapters.about: Yehoshua, mourning, Bet HaMikdash, meat, wine

summary: Mr. Dweck examines the sources and development of customs surrounding the nine days leading up to Tish'a BeAb, specifically focusing on business restrictions and the practice of abstaining from meat and wine. He discusses how Rishonim and Aharonim address these practices, noting that many customs lack explicit sources in the Mishna or Gemara and are instead justified through later interpretations and community adoption.
questions: Why do some people refrain from eating meat and drinking wine during the nine days?
Does the Mishna explicitly forbid business activities during the nine days?
How do the Rishonim explain the origin of customs that are not found in the Gemara?
What is the significance of the story about Yehoshua and the people mourning the Bet HaMikdash?
